paragraphs: COLBI Technologies develops software tools that help public agencies manage their capital building programs. It also provides in-person, hands-on training and support through a team of fiscal, construction, and facility experts.

Account-Ability, its program management application, rests on what the company calls three critical components. COLBIDocs puts agencies in control of their documents and processes without paying for expensive IT and storage systems. QualityBidders is a web-based tool that simplifies the prequalification process for contractors and agencies. It gives contractors an efficient way to comply with prequalification and CUPCCAA requirements. SecureBids provides an online, secure place to receive bids electronically.

The company maintains a national presence serving school districts and public agencies. It says it serves more than 250 clients managing more than 45 billion in capital building program dollars. It points to large capital building programs over the past 20 years in both California and Texas. The company came together after Lettie Boggs reached out to Chuck Olsen, an entrepreneur in computer programming, and it started in his garage.
